description: Procedural PBR material registry. All materials are generated at load on canvases (src/materials/textures.js) and served through getMaterial(name) (src/materials/index.js). Color maps are sRGB, normal/roughness maps linear, all RepeatWrapping. Normal maps derive from tileable procedural heightfields via a wrap-around Sobel filter. Materials with tileM expect world-space UVs (1 uv unit = tileM meters); the prop pass retrofits map geometry via worldUVs().
